title: Should have sent it back...!!
text: Should have sent it back...!!. I like the product just fine, but almost returned it because the large product label was so hard to remove, I ended up scratching the plastic. Now every time the light reflects off of it I see all the scratches.  I have never seen a label so difficult to remove.  I tried everything and wasted an hour getting really frustrated.  It wasn't worth the trouble to send it back.  But be warned the label is a real issue to remove.
